Jon M: hey devex team :wave: just started today — how do I get edit access to Notion? I can view some pages but can't edit the onboarding checklist or product docs. also where are the onboarding templates (checklist, tech spec)?
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Jon M! To request edit rights, fill out the Notion access form: https://go.redwood.com/notion-access — choose 'Edit: Docs' and list the pages you need. If you need immediate access for onboarding, mention @Samira Patel in this thread.
Samira Patel: congrats and welcome! For Notion we use SSO + group-based perms. If you can see pages but not edit, you're likely in the "Readers" group. Fill the form above (select "Edit: Docs" + pages). I can escalate once the form lands. Templates live in Redwood Docs > Templates > Onboarding. Direct link: https://redwood.notion.so/Templates-Onboarding
Alex Chen: adding path details: Redwood Docs / Product / Onboarding — contains 'New Hire Checklist' and 'Engineering 1-pager' templates. Template filenames you'll see: "Onboarding Checklist v2" and "Tech Spec - Minimal". To use a template: open the template page > ••• menu > Duplicate > move into your personal workspace or a team space. If you want contributor access to the docs git repo (for mkdocs/static site), open a docs-contrib ticket.
Marie O'Neill: note on process — edits to canonical docs should follow the docs-review workflow: add the 'docs-edit' tag on the page and mention @Marie O'Neill for a quick sanity check. Tiny copy fixes are fine to push, but architecture or process changes should have an eval + changelog entry (see Redwood Docs / Changelog).
Jon M: thanks folks — submitted the form and added the list of pages I need. quick Q: where are runbook/oncall templates? i tried Templates but didn't spot them.
Alex Chen: runbook templates live under Redwood Docs / Ops / Runbooks. Look for 'Runbook - incident response' and 'Runbook - maintenance'. If you still can't access, ping the eng-sre channel or @eng-sre.
Samira Patel: small FYI — edit group assignments are auto-reviewed after 30 days. If you need long-term edit rights, tick the "permanent access" box on the form or mention it in your request so we don't revert you.
Jon M: got edit perms :white_check_mark: found the runbook templates too. appreciate the quick responses!
Onboarding Bot: If you'd like a quick guided Notion walkthrough during week 1, book a 15m slot here: https://cal.com/redwood/onboarding-notion — select 'Notion tour'. Enjoy the docs and ping if anything else comes up!
